meta.known_bug: research.summarise raises TypeError on a one-trade frame (std of one value is null); retest.run_family inherits it for a family with exactly one trade
meta.notes: one trade: std null, t 0. Inputs are JSON and each case is recomputed from them; a raise is stored as {"raises": {"type", "message"}}. Decimals are strings, enums their values, times HH:MM:SS, naive datetimes IST. Config dicts decode by each field's declared type. Polars frames are {columns, dtypes, rows}. Regenerate with `PYTHONPATH=..:packages/core/src .venv/bin/python ../tools/parity/golden_fno.py` from decile-blueprint.
